finding_1_static_dependency_drift.agent_change: current Agent turn_affinity imports prompt_modes and binds prompt-policy fingerprint into response cache/thread identity
finding_1_static_dependency_drift.impact: the promoted installer cannot keep treating turn_affinity.py as an exact-R2 static dependency for the Agent+Core candidate; name-only closure accounting can falsely accept an incompatible static target
finding_1_static_dependency_drift.required_fix: promote turn_affinity.py to a managed composed payload (or exact-prove an equivalent installed byte identity); do not satisfy closure merely because its filename appears in R2_STATIC_DEPENDENCY_SHA256

closure_regression_hardening.new_rule: a required module may count as static only if the exact source bytes in the composed payload tree have the configured static SHA-256; otherwise STATIC_SOURCE_DRIFT is a failure

finding_2_naive_nested_PAYLOAD_NAMES_is_.backup_descriptor_issue: _durable_backup_descriptors currently derives backup name with key.replace('.', '_'); for key payload/delegation_dispatcher.py this produces 00-payload/delegation_dispatcher_py.before, which is not a basename and escapes the flat tx backup naming contract
finding_2_naive_nested_PAYLOAD_NAMES_is_.legacy_recovery_issue: _load_durable_backups recomputes expected_paths from current target_paths and requires exact keyset equality; extending PAYLOAD_NAMES would make an interrupted old-schema journal unrecoverable unless schema/version-aware legacy target recovery is retained
finding_2_naive_nested_PAYLOAD_NAMES_is_.directory_lifecycle_issue: nested bridge/payload targets require a transaction-owned directory lifecycle; current backup/write/rollback model tracks files only and cannot safely assume the nested parent already exists
required_fix: introduce an explicit source->installed-target plan instead of a flat-name-only assumption
use path-safe collision-resistant flat backup artifact names for nested target keys
version the outer journal or preserve legacy target-key recovery for interrupted v2 transactions
journal whether bridge/payload existed before mutation; create it through guarded-parent NCM28 operations; on rollback remove it only if this transaction created it and it is proven empty
include every new managed target in backup, rollback, installed marker and final exact verification
